ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
benefits_summary: Additional state financial support of ₹6,000 per year (in three ₹2,000 installments) on top of PM-KISAN, providing ₹12,000 total annual benefit to Maharashtra farmers.
exclusions: Institutional landholders and income tax-paying households
Farmers not registered under PM-KISAN in Maharashtra
application_steps: Ensure active registration and e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal with Maharashtra land records.
Verify your 7/12 land mutation with the Talathi or CSC center on nsmny.mahait.org.
Installments are credited automatically to your bank account alongside PM-KISAN.
